senses.gloss: † जृ जृ, i. 1, Par. To subdue(?).

जॄ जॄ, i. 1, Par., i. 4, Par. (also Ātm., MBh. 13, 367).
 --† ii. 9, जृणा, णी, Par.
 1. To grow old, MBh. 3, 13860.
 2. To be digested, Suśr. 1, 70, 18.
 --Ptcple. of the pres. जरन्त्, f. रती, Old, Rājat. 6, 172.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. जीर्ण,
 1. Old, decayed, Bhāg. P. 1, 13, 22; Rām. 3, 11, 9.
 2. Tumbled down, Man. 4, 46.
 3. Rotten, MBh. 3, 678.
 4. Faded, Śāk. d. 170.
 5. Destroyed, MBh. 3, 1939. n. Old age, Rājat. 3, 316.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. and i. 10,
 I. जरय, To cause to wax old, Chr. 287, 5 = Rigv. i. 48, 5; Chr. 295, 10 = Rigv. 1, 92, 10; MBh. 7, 5967 (Ātm.).
 2. To consume, Bhāg. P. 3, 25, 33.
 3. To overpower, MBh. 3, 1939.
 4. To digest, Rām. 5, 84, 12.
 II. † जारय.
 --With the prep. निस् निस्, To grind, Bhāg. P. 6, 12, 29.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To wear out, MBh. 4, 332.
 2. To fade, Suśr. 1, 224, 20.
 3. To wax old, MBh. 1, 5139.
 4. To be digested, Suśr. 2, 178, 14.
 --With प्र प्र, To be digested, Suśr. 1, 239, 1.
 --Cf. γέρων (= जरन्त्), γεραιός, γραῦς, γραΐς, γῆρας, γῦρις, γίγαρτον, γαργαλίζω, γαγγαλίζω; Lat. granum; Goth. kaurn, ga-krôtôn; O.H.G. korn, kern; Goth. qvairnu; A.S. cweorn, cwyrn.
